name: Plakuchaja iva
source:
The story begins with the mysterious disappearance of the husband of the main character, Baron Von Wolf, who disappeared a couple of days after the couple moved to the small town of Weidendorf.
A few days later he was found in the local parish of the Scarlet Rose Order. But the baroness claims that she does not recognize her husband and refuses to recognize him.
But, despite her assurances, very much confirms the identity of the impostor and no one believes her. Because of the plague quarantine, the young Baroness is a captive of her own home and begins to seriously fear for her life.
After this, a series of dramatic events unfold that will irrevocably change the life of the poor thing.
translation:
故事始於女主角的丈夫馮．沃爾夫男爵的神秘失蹤。夫妻倆剛搬到魏登多夫這座小鎮沒幾天，男爵便不見了蹤影。
幾天後，人們在緋紅玫瑰修會的當地教區找到了他。然而，男爵夫人堅稱自己不認識這個人，拒絕承認他是自己的丈夫。
儘管她再三堅持，卻有許多證據證明這個冒名頂替者就是男爵，沒有人相信她。由於瘟疫引發的隔離措施，年輕的男爵夫人被困在自己家中，開始真切地擔憂自身的性命。
此後，一連串激烈的變故接踵而至，將不可逆轉地改變這個可憐女人的人生。
